title: CacheConnection Class — CacheConnection
text: R6 class handles persistent -memory caching data used Countdown 2030 analysis reporting workflows. Dependency Architecture: Layer 0 (Core Data): Raw countdown_data, thresholds, external surveys (un_estimates). Layer 1 (DQA & Adjustments): Depends Layer 0. Layer 3 (Inequality & Health Systems): Depends Layer 2 (Coverage). Includes inequalities, mortality ratios, service utilization summaries.

"custom": Uses user-defined k_factors different indicator groups, values 0 1. title: Adjust Service Data for Coverage Analysis — adjust_service_data
text: function prepares service data series steps ensure data quality consistency: Validation: Checks structure .data ensures adjustment argument valid. custom adjustments, k_factors must specified contain valid values. k-Factor Defaults: Default k-factor values set 0.25 indicator group, unless overridden user-provided values k_factors. Reporting Completeness: Flags district-year reporting rates 75% imputes missing data using district-level medians account reporting inconsistencies. k-Factor Scaling: Adjusts service counts based k-factor reporting rate using following scaling formula: $$AdjustedValue = Value \times \left(1 + \left(\frac{1}{ReportingRate/100} - 1\right) \times k\right)$$ ReportingRate reporting rate percent, k k-factor indicator group. Outlier Detection: Identifies flags extreme outliers using Hampel's X84 method, marking values exceed 5 Median Absolute Deviations (MAD) median. Data Imputation: Replaces remaining missing values district-level medians ensure data completeness.

text: Initial Release CacheConnection now names file-backed cache source file’s basename (<stem>.rds) instead <country>_<timestamp>.rds, loads existing matching cache directly instead treating fresh parse authoritative one already present – decision now lives entirely CacheConnection , applies uniformly regardless caller. Added cd2030_mcp_server(), optional (mcptools/ellmer Suggests) Model Context Protocol server exposing read-tools – data quality, coverage, inequality, mortality, service utilization, health system, private-sector queries, plus report generation coverage charts – already-processed .rds cache, use LLM clients like Claude Desktop Claude Code. Expanded MCP server 12 38 tools, covering every remaining read-CacheConnection method (mutating setters non-data methods remain deliberately unreachable). Standardized MCP tool naming/documentation CD2030 analytical framework’s vocabulary (get_coverage_targets, get_continuum_of_care renamed match; DQA/mortality/health-system tool descriptions now cite framework’s official metric IDs named indices), added three “Equity Assessment” equiplot tools (get_equiplot_area, get_equiplot_wealth, get_equiplot_education), bringing total 41. Fixed stray print() debug statements generate_report(), generate_coverage_data(), generate_bayes_model() corrupted MCP server’s stdio JSON-RPC stream (stdout doubles wire protocol, incidental console output breaks every client response). MCP tool results now also capped total cell count (max_cells, default 5000), just row count: row-cap doesn’t protect wide table (e.g. get_indicator_coverage district level, ~190 columns), even handful rows produced megabyte-scale response crashed live client connection. Six MCP tools (get_overall_score, get_inequality, get_completeness_summary, get_outliers_summary, get_reporting_rate, get_service_utilization_summary) now read CacheConnection’s cached active bindings (e.g. reporting_rate_district) instead always calling always-recomputing calculate_*/compute_* method, whenever region filter requested – exact case bindings cover.
